staleRecords.note: Some `pass:false` records are historical, not current failures. Two causes, both fixed since:
causes: buildings/* and zoning/* shots that failed with `page.screenshot: Timeout 30000ms exceeded` predate integrator pass 2, which raised the screenshot cap to 180 s with 3 retries. The JSON shows the module rendered fine (draw calls and zero console errors were recorded) and only the capture timed out.
app/_smoke is the very first harness smoke test, whose single console error was a favicon 404. The harness now filters that.
staleRecords.current: Every module's most recent shots pass. demo: 32/32.

critic.note: Scores are the critic agent's, not the builders' self-scores. Modules fixed AFTER critic round 3 (environment r5, roads r2, zoning r2, demo r4) are not yet re-scored — a round 4 would likely raise several.

openRisks.what: The >=50 fps at 1080p budget has NEVER been measured. This environment has 2 CPUs and no GPU; every frame is software-rendered by SwiftShader at ~10 fps regardless of content.
openRisks.exposure: 1297-1361 draw calls, ~12.6M triangles, 607 clustered lights, 3 shadow cascades, a 296-call planar water reflection, GTAO, SMAA.
openRisks.mitigation: src/core/Quality.js — 5-tier adaptive governor that measures the real machine and steps quality down/up with hysteresis. Bounds the behaviour; does not measure the number.
openRisks.toClose: Run the app on real hardware and record fps per tier. Nothing else closes it.

openRisks.what: The spec's final gate — blind A/B against real Cities: Skylines II screenshots — cannot be run here. The egress proxy blocks every image source.
openRisks.why: Fabricating a reference would launder expectations into evidence.
openRisks.consequence: All art scores are the critic's unblinded, from-memory comparison. Pixel measurements in CRITIC.md are facts about our own images; the CS2 comparisons are not checkable.
openRisks.toClose: A human puts our frames beside real ones, shuffled, and picks.

openRisks.what: Every texture, mesh and sound is procedural because polyhaven.org and ambientcg.com are blocked.
openRisks.consequence: No lettering anywhere in the city, pedestrians are flat-colour figures, one cloud family. The critic put the ceiling from here at 8.5-8.75 and said above that you are fighting the absence of an art team, not the code.
